title: OpenStreetMap Eindhoven Centraal station-area extract
citation: OpenStreetMap contributors (2026). Eindhoven Centraal station-area extract retrieved from the OpenStreetMap API v0.6 map endpoint.

files.transformation: Preserve the 2026-09-05 OpenStreetMap API v0.6 XML response unchanged. Inspect only recognized geographic source observations and, when explicitly anchored, derive an uncalibrated local east/north authoring reference.

supported_primitives: Content-locked OpenStreetMap geographic observations of mapped station, entrance, pedestrian-way, step, elevator, platform, building, and indoor tags in one small Eindhoven Centraal station-area API extract.
exclusions: No claim of extract completeness, exact facility geometry, elevations, connectivity, widths, capacity, accessibility, demand, behavior, calibration, runtime validity, operational outcome, or safety evidence.
